rulingGate.verdict: BLOCKED. (1) The first admission's rows now survive under the flip: r1, r2, r3 (command route) and c1 (co-op HirePilot) keep their effect in the journal projection after the whole-campaign save, and the saved record carries balance and day; pilots are not represented by the saved record (its JSON never names the pilot) and survive in the journal. (2) A combat outcome's salvage pool survives (U35e's checkpoint carries it) and its balance survives when the host save carries the host fold; a combat-outcome debit is lost by a save built before the fold (o2u), but no production client sends a debit (missionPayout 0). (3) A combat outcome's roster change (RosterUnitChanged committed through appendCombatOutcomeBatch) is LOST from the journal projection by the host's next whole-campaign save under the flip (o1: both units back to operational; o1c: the removed unit back as destroyed), the saved record never receives it from the server, and the live co-op host then disagrees with the journal after the next co-op command. That is a real production flow: a co-op battle with any damaged or destroyed player-side unit, followed by any co-op host save. On the baseline a campaign the route creates is snapshot authority and its journal keeps the change (o1s baseline); the flip makes every new campaign journal-native, which exposes it (o1s flipped). A salvage allocation's recovered unit is lost the same way (s1), but no production flow sends one.

proposedSuccessor.behavior: Combat-outcome roster effects survive a whole-envelope save (U35d re-admission rulingGate, rows o1, o1c, o1s). (1) The combat-outcome inbox's committed batch rewrites the saved record in its own transaction, as a committed command batch does since U35e: appendCampaignCombatOutcomeBatch (src/lib/campaign/sync/campaignCombatOutcomeInbox.ts:68-143) runs the store's rewriteRecordAfterCommand (passed by appendCombatOutcomeBatch, JournalCampaignEventStore.ts:467-484, as appendCommandBatch passes it at :443) only when the outcome had no inbox receipt, so the row version advances and the host adopts the record through U35f's refresh instead of checkpointing a pre-outcome envelope over it. (2) The rewrite (src/lib/campaign/authority/campaignRecordJournalState.ts:97-125, today balance and date only) also writes the journal's roster onto the record's roster projection (operational/damaged/destroyed to Ready/Damaged/Destroyed), so the next checkpoint re-projects the roster the journal holds. Red-first: this admission's rows o1, o1c and o1s (saved copy and sha256 in evidence/u35d-admission-20260924.json), red on 2199b53f6 under the temporary flip.
proposedSuccessor.estimate: INFERENCE, not measured: 4-6 files, about 80-150 product lines (the inbox hook and its wiring, the roster patch in the rewrite) plus a red-rows suite on the U35e fixture
openQuestionsForTheParent: A destroyed unit is RosterUnitChanged "removed" in the journal (CampaignMatchHostOutcomeInbox.ts:190; applyCampaignEvent.ts:47-50) but Destroyed readiness in the host roster store (useCampaignRosterStore.ts:231-268). Either the rewrite drops the unit from the record's roster projection AND from its force's unitIds (projectForceUnits refuses a force naming an absent unit, campaignSourceGenesis.ts:142-146), keeping the event vocabulary; or the outcome derives a status change to destroyed instead of a removal (an edit under src/lib/multiplayer/server, owned by R2.authority-live), keeping the record's Destroyed readiness. The parent or the owner decides.

A SalvageAllocated.recoveredUnit has no production producer, and a journal roster unit without a catalog ref cannot be written to the record's roster projection (projectRosterUnits refuses a unit with no unitRef, campaignSourceGenesis.ts:111-113); the successor either scopes recoveredUnit out (row s1 recorded as a non-claim) or refuses a recoveredUnit without a unitRef at the intent validator (src/lib/multiplayer/server).

Idempotency: the rewrite must run only on the inbox's first receipt, not on the duplicate or version-conflict arms (campaignCombatOutcomeInbox.ts:90-101), mirroring U35e's recorded-command guard (JournalCampaignEventStore.ts:310-319).
